markdown: ## Watchlist - **JPMorgan:** It has signed a strategic partnership with OpenAI to use the lab's coding and cybersecurity models [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/48718/jpmorgan-chase-signs-cybersecurity-and-coding-deal-with-openai?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). Ask your coverage team how this will show up in JPMorgan's fraud screening and its treasury-services platforms. ## The brief - **The US added 165,000 jobs in October, far above forecasts, and unemployment dipped to 4.1%** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/f84c722c-99a9-4628-84dc-c42a192cb35c?syn-25a6b1a6=1)[CFO Dive](https://www.cfodive.com/news/unemployment-rate-dips-surge-hiring-shatters-expectations-fed-inflation-jobs-economy/874049/). Markets now expect the Fed to raise rates in December, which means higher USD funding costs and better returns on dollar cash. - **ECB President Lagarde has hinted at a December rate hike and expects inflation to stay high in the near future** [MarketWatch](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxQbHE5UDMyTTMtOE1JVHNSd2E3Qm1OZzQxTlgxMzRQa292ODZScGhCdUlyR2doTU9FMDlxcHBvbGxCZGZKaDR2Vmk3dnEtUEwzTzdrMFpQY1NyVlhwWm84RERQZ1k1SGRDUDBndmJTbjNUd3lsR25lWkVORnNtREx2WVZsaElPQ0ZCSW5wT3BPRFdEbV91VkFsdzJHZmktbWpRcjh1TnRRRzBoZzdtaUJ2WGRGLUZadGxCTkE?oc=5)[Bloomberg.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOTjNxNHB3bnV6QkhJdWVmNHZpeTVVUVVqRG5vV0MwdHVzdE41TWtFd2lJcGlLNTh3ZzhDZ2tFQkVOakVkcm5xcndlanN1UnIyQ3V1bnVPZldQSW11OVFfWjZuMFZfS192bmVNLUR0cl8waHFuZ1hmWUdQNlpKc0xuVXl5MGF6aHVJVXh0ckhSQmJiOFBzTDViQTR0NmlKNmhzNFhNa2xvS2VqbDRyWWRybW1jN3o?oc=5). EUR deposit yields and borrowing costs are heading higher, so revisit how euro cash is laddered and the cost of carry on EUR hedges. - **Houthi strikes damaged Saudi Aramco's office tower in Riyadh** [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/content/eeadc13e-b915-4591-ab85-54db81030996?syn-25a6b1a6=1). Renewed attacks on Gulf energy targets are a risk to oil prices, freight and input costs, and could unwind the recent relief in energy prices. - **CoreWeave's bond yield has topped 16%** [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/coreweave-bond-yield-tops-16percent-as-ai-credit-stress-rises.html). Investors are worried about a slowdown in data-centre building. A cooling AI buildout could soften one source of commercial HVAC demand, so watch it as a planning assumption. ## Rates & FX - **US yields rose after the jobs data.** The 2-year is 4.51% (+5bp) and the 10-year is 4.86% (+2bp), though both are still lower on the week (-5bp and -8bp). SOFR is 3.92%. Fed's Daly says more hikes are likely [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/fed-daly-interest-rates-inflation.html). - **FX.** Today's snapshot only has EUR/GBP, which is flat at 0.8341. The other currency pairs are missing, so check live rates before hedging. - **Calendar.** Nothing high-impact today. US CPI is on Tuesday at 13:30 Dublin, forecast at +0.3% (after +0.6%), with core at +0.2%. A hot number would firm up a December Fed hike and push the dollar and short-term rates up. UK GDP follows on Thursday and US PPI on Friday. ## Also worth knowing - **Huntington has launched Intelligent Treasury**, a platform that aims to give commercial clients cash visibility across multiple banks [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/111599/huntington-national-bank-launches-treasury-management-platform?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). - **Austrian property funds face a rush for cash after a rates blow-up** [Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPbDhlajFYNjFiN05SdVZQVU41RGhuOHdWU0FFbzBTa2hySHkwQ2VJYTFCdDFXZ2trSFJ5Mk9BbktZUzN6S2o4YUdxUUVzSy1Pb0JBQ2hKeG1zZEVwbGVZcXBWeXFNeG9uMnVtd1RseDZxVzlJR3JVSGJhYU1vNWdqY3NYWDI5dmZnTWtfb0d0akZncUF3Q3NsYUF5NjdrZ0lKNmVfUXgxcGNPUDMwLUR5aW5MVm0?oc=5). This is a reminder of liquidity risk in less liquid investment vehicles. - **Lear is opening an automated factory in Michigan as a "blueprint" for its global network** [Manufacturing Dive](https://www.manufacturingdive.com/news/lear-automated-factory-blueprint-global-network/873986/). - **B2B payments fintech Pliant has raised $80m in a Series C round** [Finextra](https://www.finextra.com/pressarticle/111604/b2b-payments-firm-pliant-raises-80?utm_medium=rssfinextra&utm_source=finextrafeed). ## Worth thinking about The Fed, ECB and Bank of England all now lean towards tightening, yet US long-term yields are lower on the week. That is a narrow window for locking in term funding or extending the duration of short-term investments. It is worth asking the team whether surplus USD cash should be moved further out the curve before Tuesday's CPI decides the question.
